# Hearted - Complete Documentation

> Safari extension for saving and archiving your favorite content from social media and creative platforms.

For summary version, see: [llms.txt](https://h3arted.com/llms.txt)

## Product Overview

Hearted is a privacy-first Safari extension for iOS and macOS that lets you archive content you've liked, saved, or want to reference later. All data stays on your device - no accounts, no cloud tracking.

## How It Works

1. **Install**: Download from App Store and enable Safari extension
2. **Browse**: Visit supported platforms normally
3. **Save**: Tap the Hearted icon to archive any supported content
4. **Organize**: Tag and categorize your saved content
5. **Export**: Export your archive as JSON or Markdown

## Supported Platforms

### X (Twitter)
- Tweets and threads
- Images and videos
- User profiles
- Bookmarks sync

### Pinterest
- Individual pins
- Board collections
- Saved ideas

### Instagram
- Posts and reels
- Stories (before expiration)
- Saved collections

### Midjourney
- Generated images
- Prompt history
- Variations and upscales

## Key Features

### Privacy-First Architecture
- **Local Storage**: All data stored on-device using SwiftData
- **No Tracking**: Zero analytics or telemetry
- **No Accounts**: Works with just your Apple ID (optional iCloud sync)
- **No External Servers**: Content never leaves your device

### Organization
- **Tags**: Create custom tags for categorization
- **Search**: Full-text search across all saved content
- **Filters**: Filter by platform, date, or tags
- **Collections**: Group related content together

### Export Options
- **JSON**: Full structured export for data portability
- **Markdown**: Human-readable format for notes
- **Claude Code Integration**: Export for AI analysis

### Cross-Platform
- **iOS**: iPhone and iPad support
- **macOS**: Mac Safari extension
- **iCloud Sync**: Optional sync between devices

## Technical Details

### Requirements
- iOS 17.0+ or macOS 14.0+
- Safari browser
- Approximately 50MB storage

### Architecture
- SwiftUI native interface
- SwiftData for local persistence
- Safari Web Extension APIs
- Optional CloudKit for sync

### Privacy Manifest
Hearted includes an iOS Privacy Manifest declaring:
- No tracking domains
- No third-party analytics
- Local storage only

## Use Cases

### For Creators
- Build inspiration archives
- Save reference material
- Track creative trends
- Export prompts for AI tools

### For Researchers
- Archive social content before deletion
- Organize research materials
- Export structured data
- Build personal knowledge bases

### For General Users
- Save content to read later
- Organize bookmarks across platforms
- Back up important content locally
- Keep content private and portable

## Pricing

- **Free**: Core functionality at no cost
- **No Subscription**: One-time download
- **No In-App Purchases**: All features included
